# P-12 NYSED

> New York State Education Department's K-12 portal providing funding, grants, school improvement programs, and education resources for public schools.

P-12 NYSED serves as the central hub for New York State's public education initiatives, offering grant opportunities, procurement information, and specialized programs including support for bilingual education, math access, and schools for students with sensory disabilities. The site connects educators, administrators, and districts to federal and state funding mechanisms including Title I grants, ESSA compliance resources, and Contracts for Excellence programs.

## Key Topics

- NYSED
- P-12 Education
- Title I Grants
- School Funding
- ESSA (Every Student Succeeds Act)

## Core Resources & Home

- [P-12 NYSED Homepage](https://p12.nysed.gov): Main portal for K-12 funding, grants, and school improvement programs
- [Program Offices Directory](https://www.p12.nysed.gov/offices.html): Directory of NYSED P-12 offices, BOCES, and specialized schools including NYSSB and NYSSD

## Funding & Grants

- [Current Grant Applications](https://www.p12.nysed.gov/funding/currentapps.html): Active grant applications for Title I, LSTA, and school improvement funding opportunities
- [Contracts for Excellence (C4E)](https://www.p12.nysed.gov/mgtserv/C4E/home.html): C4E program documentation, Foundation Aid information, and educational management resources

## Procurement & Contracts

- [Competitive Procurements](https://www.p12.nysed.gov/compcontracts/compcontracts.html): RFP announcements and competitive bidding opportunities for NYSED contracts

## Resources & Reference

- [Resources Directory](https://www.p12.nysed.gov/resources): Comprehensive resource directory for school administration, funding data, and educational programs

## News & Updates

- [P-12 News](https://p12.nysed.gov/news.html): Latest news and updates on grants, programs, school improvement initiatives, and policy changes
